__instructions__: Paste each note's full text body under its title. SHINE searches the text for required disclosures (Level 3 reconciliation language, related-party terms, subsequent-events date, etc.). Order does not matter. Delete the __ lines before saving.

notes.title: Organization
notes.text: Paste your Organization note here, including the regulator registration sentence (Private Funds Act for Cayman, CSSF for Luxembourg).

notes.title: Significant accounting policies
notes.text: Paste your accounting policies note here, including the basis of presentation, investment measurement, income recognition.

notes.title: Fair value measurements
notes.text: Paste your fair value note here, including the Level 1/2/3 hierarchy, the Level 3 reconciliation roll-forward language, and significant unobservable inputs disclosure.

notes.title: Investments and concentration
notes.text: Paste your investments note here, including >5 percent name-level disclosure.

notes.title: Related party transactions
notes.text: Paste your related party note here, naming the General Partner / Investment Manager and amounts.

notes.title: Subsequent events
notes.text: Paste your subsequent events note here, INCLUDING the date through which events were evaluated.

notes.title: Recently issued accounting standards
notes.text: Paste your recent ASUs note here.
